title: Variable injectivity of a converted clause
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $lits$ be a list of Boolean-circuit literals on $n$ variables whose variable indices are pairwise distinct. Convert the AND-clause built from $lits$ into a term by replacing each circuit literal with its corresponding switching-lemma literal. Any two literals in that term with the same variable are equal.
hypotheses_covered: The variable indices in $lits$ are pairwise distinct
Both literals occur in the converted term
The two literals have the same variable
replaced:
Let $lits$ be a list of circuit literals on $n$ variables whose variable indices are
pairwise distinct, and let $C$ be the AND-clause built from $lits$. If $\ell_1$ and
$\ell_2$ are any two literals occurring in the term obtained by converting $C$, and
$\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$ have the same variable, then $\ell_1 = \ell_2$.
